A '''reanimated horror''' can be spawned by casting the [[Arceuus spellbook|spell]] [[Adept Reanimation]] on an [[ensouled horror head]]. Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has done one of these things, they will no longer be able to reanimate the creature in the area where it was killed, but can still reanimate it within range of the [[Dark Altar]]. Killing the creature will grant the player 832 [[Prayer]] [[experience]].

Even though the head is dropped by both [[jungle horror]]s and [[cave horror]]s, the reanimated creature counts '''only''' towards jungle horror [[Slayer task]]s. They '''do not''' count as cave horrors, and similarly, a [[witchwood icon]] is '''not required''' to kill them.
